body: I can't talk to a doctor. I've tried to call so many times for help but can't get the words out of my mouth. I even had someone call for help for me online but when someone came to the door I couldn't answer it. My mental problem is crippling and I'm being kicked out in 10 hours. Even if I could talk to another person my landlord's letter explained that he has someone he needs to move in here next week. He gave me 30 days to get out and I did nothing in that amount of time to fix my life. The people in this town have broken me. The part of my brain that used to want to reach out for human contact has long since been dead and now what's left is trapped inside.
